title: Ruling Handoff Package
description: Self-contained context package for an issue that bounded HS extraction slice has flagged for full adjudication. Each package includes enough context for full adjudication to proceed without re-reading bounded HS extraction slice outputs.

hs_slice_position.description: The AA's promoted classification for this component (e.g. '8537.10 (US + India, stable)'). The baseline adjudication handoff starts from.

aa_classification_candidate.description: Full ClassificationCandidate record from AA (embedded for full adjudication context)

ruling_records_involved.description: RulingRecord IDs from the PRA that are relevant to this handoff item

contradiction_record.description: ContradictionRecord if this handoff arose from a surfaced contradiction

open_question_for_ruling.description: Precise question full adjudication needs to answer (e.g. 'Is NY N329827 still current, or has it been superseded by a later HQ ruling?')

jurisdiction_divergence_detail.description: When reason_for_handoff = cross_jurisdiction_divergence: the two AA candidates for different jurisdictions
